questions.question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.
To be in two minds
options: To be dominated by someone else
To work on somebody else's advice
To be in a critical state
questions.solution: D)To be in two minds(idiom) – To be uncertain अनिश्चित होना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate idiomatic expression to fill in the blank.
Anita keeps on repeating that she is innocent, but there is ___________.
options: no pulling up of the socks
questions.solution: A)'no smoke without fire'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि यह idiom उस स्थिति को दर्शाता है जब किसी बात का होने का संकेत मिलता है, भले ही स्पष्ट सबूत न हो। यहाँ, अनिता के निर्दोषताकी बार-बार चर्चा हो रही है, और मुहावरा इस संदर्भ में सबसे उपयुक्त है कि कुछ न कुछ तो गड़बड़ है। इसलिए, "no smoke without fire" सबसे उपयुक्त विकल्प होगा।

questions.question:

His voice gets on my nerves.
questions.solution: C)Get on my nerves(phrase) – Irritates me परेशान करना

questions.question:

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate idiom/phrase that can substitute the given group of words.
The better you know someone the less you like him.
questions.solution: D) Familiarity breeds contempt(phrase) – The better you know someone, the less you like him. जितना अधिक जानते हो, उतना ही कम पसंद करते हो.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.
Hard nut to crack
options: A situation that can be altered
questions.solution: A)Hard nut to crack(idiom) – A problem difficult to solve एक कठिन समस्या जिसे हल करना मुश्किल है।

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.
Treading on thin ice
options: To be in a dangerous risky position
Skating on ice fallen in a hailstorm
questions.solution: B)Treading on thin ice(idiom) – To be in a dangerous risky position संकटपूर्ण स्थिति में होना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate phrasal verb to fill in the blank.
The driver very subtly ___________ the traffic violation he committed.
questions.solution: C) 'Ironed out' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि "ironed out" का अर्थ होता है किसी समस्या या विवाद को हल कर देना। जबकि 'Ironed through' का कोई विशेष अर्थ नहीं होता, 'Ironed in' का अर्थ है किसी चीज को स्थायी रूप से निवेश करना, और 'Ironed aside' का अर्थ है किसी चीज को नकार या ताल देना, जो इस संदर्भ में सही नहीं है।

questions.question:

My cousin sister Neetu had an aerial view of the trade fair from the top of the giantwheel.
options: A bird in the gilded cage
questions.solution: B)Bird’s eye view(phrase) – a view from a very high place that allows you to see a large area सरसरी निगाह

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.
Blow something out of (all) proportion.
options: Make things difficult for someone without reason
Leave someone at a time when they need you to stay and help them

Behave as if something that has happened is much worse than it really is
questions.solution: D)Blow something out of (all) proportion(idiom) – Behave as if something that has happened is much worse than it really is वास्तविकता से अधिक बुरा व्यवहार करना।

questions.question:

To bear the negative consequences of wrongful actions
questions.solution: D)To face the music(idiom) – To bear the negative consequences of wrongful actionsअपनीगलती की सजा भुगतना।

questions.solution: A)Stir up a hornets' nest(idiom) – Provoke trouble परेशानी पैदा करना
